locations.rationale: The function identifier is passed as the lua_CFunction argument to Internal::setMgrFn while registering the top-level Lua binding named "bind"; it resolves to the file-local static hlBind declaration.

records.rationale: A project-wide exact-identifier search found only the selected static function declaration and its registration use. Inspection of the registration helper confirms that hlBind is consumed as a Lua C-function pointer. The required set is therefore complete, with no import/export binding tokens or unresolved ambiguity.
